description: Golden file for basic and spectral analysis of a 440Hz sine kick

spectral_centroid.description: Should be near 440Hz for pure sine

spectral_rolloff.description: Should be close to fundamental frequency

zero_crossing_rate.description: Pure sine has consistent low ZCR

notes: This golden file defines acceptable ranges rather than exact values
Spectral features may vary slightly due to windowing and FFT
Values are based on theoretical expectations for a pure 440Hz sine wave
